title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, cut pancetta into small cubes and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together egg yolks and grated cheese until smooth.
When pasta is done, reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Add hot pasta to the skillet with pancetta, remove from heat.
Quickly pour egg mixture over pasta, tossing constantly to create a creamy sauce.
Add pasta water as needed to reach desired consistency.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the tikka masala spice for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry the marinated chicken until charred and cooked through. Set aside.
In a large pan, melt butter and sauté onion until golden.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in remaining tikka masala spice and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in tomato puree and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add heavy cream and stir to combine.
Add the grilled chicken pieces and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
summary: A quick and healthy vegetable stir fry with a savory soy-ginger sauce.
instructions: Prepare all vegetables and set aside.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic in a small bowl.
Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add a tablespoon of oil and stir fry vegetables for 3-4 minutes.
Pour sauce over vegetables and toss to coat evenly.
Cook for another 2 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

title: Classic Beef Burger
summary: Juicy homemade beef burger with all the classic toppings.
instructions: Divide ground beef into 4 equal portions and form into patties.
Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook patties for 4-5 minutes per side for medium doneness.
Add cheese slice in the last minute of cooking to melt.
Toast burger buns lightly on the grill.
Assemble burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and condiments.
Serve immediately with fries or salad.
